# Muskaan Singh

> Fashion designer, content creator, and founder of Label Muskaan Singh and Ibtida.

Muskaan Singh is a Kolkata-based fashion designer and content creator. She is the founder of Label Muskaan Singh, a luxury ethnic wear brand specialising in Chikankari, and Ibtida, an accessible everyday ethnic wear sub-brand launched in 2025.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.muskaansingh.in/): Portfolio homepage with hero, celebrity features, and Instagram grid
- [About](https://www.muskaansingh.in/about): Background, story, and milestones
- [Brand](https://www.muskaansingh.in/brand): Label Muskaan Singh and Ibtida brand pages
- [Collection](https://www.muskaansingh.in/collection): All ethnic wear collections
- [Content](https://www.muskaansingh.in/content): Brand collaborations and content creation work
- [Press](https://www.muskaansingh.in/press): Media coverage and press features
- [Contact](https://www.muskaansingh.in/contact): Contact and collaboration enquiry forms
